questions.question: What is HTML?
questions.ideal_answer: HTML is the standard markup language used to structure web pages.

questions.question: What is CSS?
questions.ideal_answer: CSS styles HTML elements and controls layout, colors and responsiveness.

questions.question: What is JavaScript?
questions.ideal_answer: JavaScript adds interactivity and dynamic behavior to web pages.

questions.question: What is Responsive Design?
questions.ideal_answer: Responsive design ensures websites work across different screen sizes.

questions.question: What is React?
questions.ideal_answer: React is a JavaScript library for building user interfaces.

questions.question: Explain Flexbox.
questions.ideal_answer: Flexbox is a CSS layout model for arranging elements efficiently.

questions.question: Explain CSS Grid.
questions.ideal_answer: CSS Grid creates two-dimensional layouts using rows and columns.

questions.question: What are React Components?
questions.ideal_answer: Reusable building blocks used to create React applications.

questions.question: What is State Management?
questions.ideal_answer: Managing and updating application data across components.

questions.question: What is Redux?
questions.ideal_answer: Redux is a state management library for JavaScript applications.

questions.question: Optimize a React App.
questions.ideal_answer: Use memoization, lazy loading and efficient rendering techniques.

questions.question: What is Virtual DOM?
questions.ideal_answer: A lightweight copy of the DOM used to improve performance.

questions.question: Improve Web Performance.
questions.ideal_answer: Minify assets, lazy load resources and optimize images.

questions.question: Accessible UI?
questions.ideal_answer: Use semantic HTML, keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes.

questions.question: Frontend Architecture?
questions.ideal_answer: Organized structure for components, state and routing.
